name: Lift Tube
text: May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move without presence aboard. Also, may move as a 'react' only to a battle or Force drain (if within range).

name: C-3PO (See-Threepio)
text: Total power at same site is +2 for each of your droid/Rebel pairs present, including C-3PO. R2-D2 is forfeit +2 when present.

name: R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)
text: While aboard any starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver and hyperspeed (3 on Red 5). If at a Scomp link when opponent draws destiny of: 1-3, you may activate one Force; 4-6, you may draw top card from Reserve Deck.

name: Han Solo
text: Once during battle, may use 1 Force to cancel and re-draw your just drawn destiny. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Falcon, also adds 2 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Smoke Screen
text: During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the ability number of one of your characters involved in the battle.

name: Gambler’s Luck
text: If your gambler is defending a battle alone at a site, add one battle destiny (draw two destiny and choose one). OR If your Lando is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny (draw three destiny and choose two).

name: Lando Calrissian
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if piloting Falcon). Power +1 for every Cloud City location you control. When playing Sabacc, may add 1 to or subtract 1 from your total.

name: Lieutenant Commander Ardan
text: If at a site, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Immune to attrition < X, where X = the number of opponent's aliens present.

name: Secret Plans
text: Plays on table. If opponent is about to retrieve X Force, opponent must first use X Force or that retrieval is canceled. (X is equal to the full amount of Force allowed to be retrieved, regardless of the number of cards in opponent's Lost Pile.)

name: Navy Trooper Fenson
text: Subtracts 3 from Force opponent retrieves for On The Edge and Off The Edge. When at Bunker, adds 2 to deploy cost of each opponent's character (except Ewoks, spies and scouts) to Endor sites (except Rebel Landing Site).

name: Sergeant Tarl
text: While Tarl is the trooper targeted by Spice Mines of Kessel, that Utinni Effect is immune to Alter and Tarl adds 4 to Force retrieved when completed. Subtracts 3 from Force opponent retrieves with Noble Sacrifice.

name: Noble Sacrifice
text: If opponent just deployed a character, sacrifice (out of play) from table one of your characters with the same power (even a captured character). You may retrieve Force from Lost Pile equal to your sacrificed character's forfeit value.

name: On The Edge
text: Use 1 Force and target one Rebel (on table) of ability > 2. Choose a number from 1 to 6. You may retrieve that amount from your Lost Pile if you now draw destiny > chosen number. If you fail, Rebel is lost.

name: Off The Edge
text: Target one of your characters at a Cloud City site. Draw destiny. If destiny > character's destiny number, retrieve Force equal to the distance. If destiny < character's destiny number, lose difference. If destiny = character's destiny number, character is lost.

name: Tonnika Sisters
text: Twice during each of your control phases, may use 2 Force to draw 2 destiny for 2 chances at a destiny = 2. If successful, may steal or destroy up to 2 weapons or 2 devices present.

name: Labria
text: Once each turn, during your control phase, you may reveal the top card of your Reserve Deck to both players. If it is a vehicle or starship, card is immediately lost. Otherwise, return it to the top of your Reserve Deck, Force Pile or Used Pile.

name: Djas Puhr
text: Power +1 for each [Dark Side Force] present, +2 under 'nighttime conditions.' Immune to attrition < 3.

name: BoShek
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. Immune to attrition < 3.

name: URoRRuR'R'R
text: Deploys only on on Tatooine. When at same site as another Tusken Raider, may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Rebel Scout
text: May move as a 'react' (for free) to a battle where you have a Rebel of ability > 2 or a leader.

name: Y-wing
text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

name: Snowtrooper
text: Deploys only on Hoth. Power -1 when not at a Hoth site.

name: TIE Fighter
text: Deploy -1 to same system as any Imperial capital starship. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

name: Dr. Evazan
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. The not-so-good doctor may 'operate' on any other character present that was just 'hit' or just Disarmed; 'patient' is lost.

name: Echo Base Trooper
text: Deploy only on Hoth, but may move elsewhere. Power -1 when at a site other than a Hoth site.

name: Luke Skywalker
text: While Luke is not on Tatooine your total Force generation is +1. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.

name: Commander Luke Skywalker
text: Deploys only on Hoth. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Rogue 1, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. Adds 1 to forfeit of each other Rogue Squadron pilot or gunner at same Hoth site.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
text: When a battle was just initiated where present, may use 1 Force to choose one opponent's character of ability = 1 present to move away (for free), or that character is lost. Immune to attrition < 5.

name: Lando Calrissian
text: Deploys only on Cloud City. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When playing Sabacc, may subtract 1 from or add 1 to your total. If present at a site, can be replaced by opponent with any Light Side Lando.

name: Son Of Skywalker
text: Deploys only on Dagobah or Cloud City. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, during your deploy phase, a lightsaber may deploy on Luke (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.

name: Alter
text: Cancel one Effect (or Utinni Effect) by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Sense card just played.

name: Sense
text: Cancel one Interrupt (or one 'react') by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Alter card just played.

name: Alter
text: Cancel one Effect (or Utinni Effect) by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Sense card just played.

name: Sense
text: Cancel one Interrupt (or one 'react') by drawing a destiny < ability of your highest-ability character on table. OR Cancel one Alter card just played.

name: For Luck
text: Deploy on table. If Counter Assault is played, may use 1 Force to add one destiny to your total. If Sense or Alter just played, may use X Force to exclude X Dark Jedi from being the 'highest-ability character.'

name: Dark Forces
text: Deploy on your side of table. When Surprise Assault is played, may use 1 Force to add one destiny to your total. Also, when Sense or Alter is played, may use X Force to exclude X Jedi from being the 'highest-ability character.'

name: Yoda
text: Deploy on Dagobah I must, but move elsewhere I may, yes. When the mentor, 1 to training destiny I add. Where present am I, battles and attacks happen not unless present a Dark Side character of ability > 3 there is. To attrition, immune am I.

name: Emperor Palpatine
text: Never deploys or moves (even aboard a starship or vehicle) to a site opponent occupies. Where present, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Vader over. Once per turn, you may take Force Lightning into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition.

name: Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight
text: Deploys -3 to Home One or Endor. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Power +2 when armed with a lightsaber. Subtracts 3 from any attempt to cross him over (even if captured). Immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if alone or armed with a lightsaber, < 7 if both).

name: Scramble
text: Deploy on opponent's side of table. Opponent's pilots (except Vader) present at sites may not use ability to draw battle destiny. Effect canceled when opponent has no pilots at sites.

name: K'lor'slug
text: Deploy on your side of table. For each unit of ability you have present during a battle, you may use 1 Force to raise your total power by 1. Ability used in this way cannot also be used to draw destiny.

name: Molator
text: Deploy on your side of table. For each unit of ability you have present during a battle, you may use 1 Force to raise your total power by 1. Ability used in this way cannot also be used to draw destiny.

name: Darth Vader
text: When in battle, adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws. Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (or 4 to power and 3 to maneuver if Vader's Custom TIE). Immune to attrition < 5.

name: Affect Mind
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on one of your Jedi. While present at a site, unless a Dark Jedi is also present, opponent's total ability at same location is reduced by 2.

name: Ability, Ability, Ability
text: Deploy on opponent's side of table. At the end of opponent's deploy phase, if they did not deploy a card with ability, opponent loses 2 Force. Effect lost if opponent has more cards with ability on table than you. Immune to Alter.

name: Focused Attack
text: If Vader is present during a battle at a site, for remainder of turn, he loses his immunity to attrition, but adds ability to power (he may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny). OR During a duel, add one destiny to your total.

name: Courage Of A Skywalker
text: One of your Skywalkers present during a battle at a site, for remainder of turn, loses immunity to attrition but adds ability to power (he or she may not apply ability toward drawing battle destiny). OR During a duel, add one destiny to your total.

name: Trooper Assault
text: If a battle was just initiated at a site, each of your troopers present is power +2 and immune to attrition for remainder of turn.

name: Jedi Lightsaber
text: Use X Force to deploy on your warrior where X = (7 - warrior's ability). May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature by using X Force. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Obi-Wan's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Obi-Wan. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

name: Vader's Lightsaber
text: Deploy on Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.

name: Dams Denna
text: Once during your deploy phase, you may deploy a Kaadu, Fambaa or Eopie to same site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just lost a creature vehicle from same site, you may place that creature in your Used Pile.

name: Mandalorian Armor
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on any Imperial or alien (except Vader or Boba Fett). Character is power +2, has armor = 5 and is immune to attrition < 3.

name: Corporal Delevar
text: Prevents your characters from having their forfeit reduced at same location (and at Hoth sites if Delevar is at Echo Med Lab). When with your FX droid, once per turn allows your character just forfeited from same site to be placed in Used Pile.

name: FX-7 (Effex-Seven)
text: Once per turn, one of your 'hit' non-droid characters at same or adjacent site may be placed in your Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited. Cumulatively subtracts 2 from X on your Bacta Tank.
rulesNote: Current official erratum (Advanced Rulebook p113). Forfeiture replacement and cumulative Bacta Tank X reduction implemented for active ground droids.

name: Hoth: Echo Med Lab
text: DARK: If you control, with an Imperial present, Force drain +1 here. LIGHT: Once per turn, one of your medical droids is deploy -2.

name: Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
text: DARK: Your docking bay transit from here requires 3 Force. Your transit to here requires +4 Force. LIGHT: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.

name: FX-10 (Effex-ten)
text: Once per turn, one of your 'hit' non-droid characters at same or adjacent site may be placed in your Used Pile instead of Lost Pile when forfeited.
rulesNote: Current official erratum (Advanced Rulebook p113): forfeiture only.

name: Bacta Tank
text: Use 4 Force to deploy on your side of table. A non-droid character you just lost may be placed here. Holds 1 'patient' at a time. During your deploy phase, may use X Force to bring 'patient' to hand, where X = deploy cost of 'patient.'
rulesNote: Official AR p104 erratum. Current ground loss/patient recovery components; broader modifiers and aboard states remain pending.

name: Bad Feeling Have I
text: Deploy on opponent's side of table. Luke, Leia, Han, Chewie, Lando, Yoda, and Obi-Wan are deploy +2. Also, opponent may not play any cards with the words 'bad feeling' in the title.

name: Hoth: Echo Docking Bay
text: DARK: Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force. LIGHT: Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.

name: Commander Praji
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Devastator, also adds 1 to hyperspeed. Where present, cancels game text of C-3PO or R2-D2.

name: Grand Moff Tarkin
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When with Vader in a battle, once per battle may cancel one opponent's destiny just drawn.

name: Beru Lars
text: Forfeit +2 when at same site as Owen Lars or a Hydroponics Station. If lost from table during opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

name: Owen Lars
text: Deploys free at Lars' Moisture Farm. Power +2 if at same site as Beru Lars or a Vaporator. If lost from table during opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn.

name: Hydroponics Station
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any exterior Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. The first Force you activate during your activate phase may be drawn into hand instead. If a Vaporator on table, the second Force you activate may also be drawn into hand.

name: Vaporator
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on any Tatooine site. Cannot be moved. Protects all characters at same site, or an adjacent site, from Gravel Storm.

name: Gravel Storm
text: Strikes at Dune Sea, Jundland Wastes, Beggar's Canyon, Lars' Moisture Farm, Jawa Camp, or Mos Eisley. Target opponent's character present at that site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > ability.

name: Beru Stew
text: Each player must immediately activate 2 Force. Also, you may activate 1 additional Force for each Beru Lars, Owen Lars or Hydroponics Station on table.

name: Cloud City: Chasm Walkway
text: If Weather Vane on table, characters 'hit' here are instead immediately relocated there.

name: A Tremor In The Force
text: Once per game, during your deploy phase, 'insert' (face down) into opponent's Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When effect reaches top it is immediately lost, but opponent may not activate any more Force that turn. (Immune to Alter.)

name: A Disturbance In The Force
text: Once per game, during your deploy phase, 'insert' (face down) into opponent's Reserve Deck; reshuffle. When effect reaches top it is immediately lost, but opponent may not activate any more Force that turn. (Immune to Alter.)

name: The Dark Path
text: Deploy on your side of table. Once per turn, you may peek at the top three cards of your Reserve Deck. Place any two of those three in your Lost Pile.

name: Anger, Fear, Aggression
text: 'Insert' in opponent's Reserve Deck. When Effect reaches top it is lost, but opponent must initiate a battle by the end of opponent's next battle phase or lose 4 Force. (Immune to Alter.)

name: Projective Telepathy
text: Cancel Anger, Fear, Aggression when it is inserted or revealed. OR If your opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain, opponent must choose to use 2 Force, or cancel that battle or Force drain.

name: Sandcrawler
text: Deploys only to a Tatooine site. May add 1 driver and 7 passengers. Cannot move to mobile sites. Adds 1 to forfeit of each Jawa at same exterior site.

name: Tatooine
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.

name: Tatooine
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Tatooine sites.

name: Sunsdown
text: Deploy on any planet system to cause 'nighttime conditions' at related sites. During battles there, both sides add one destiny to power only. Spies deploy free to sites under 'nighttime conditions.'

name: TIE Scout
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 passenger, or 2 passengers. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

name: Sandcrawler
text: Deploys only to a Tatooine site. May add 1 driver and 7 passengers. May relocate only to planet sites. Adds 1 to forfeit of each Jawa at same exterior site.

name: Yavin 4
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.

name: Yavin 4
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Yavin 4 sites.

name: Corellian Corvette
text: May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

name: Imperial-Class Star Destroyer
text: May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.

name: Gold 1
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers.

name: Black 3
text: May add 1 pilot.

name: Dutch
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Gold 1, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Adds 1 to forfeit of each other Gold Squadron pilot at same location.

name: DS-61-3
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Luke's X-34 Landspeeder
text: May add 1 driver and 2 passengers. Moves free if Luke aboard. May move as a 'react.'

name: SoroSuub V-35 Landspeeder
text: May add 1 driver and 3 passengers. Moves free if Owen Lars, Beru Lars or Luke aboard. May move as a 'react'.

name: Ubrikkian 9000 Z001
text: May add 1 driver and 2 passengers. May move as a 'react.'

name: Red 1
text: May add 1 pilot. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

name: Proton Torpedoes
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your X-wing, Y-wing or B-wing. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny > defense value.

name: Quad Laser Cannon
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Corellian Corvette or Falcon. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a starfighter. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Turbolaser Battery
text: Use 3 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer or any mobile system. May target a starship using 2 Force. Draw two destiny. Subtract 2 if targeting a capital starship. Otherwise, subtract 5. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Death Star
text: Dark: X = parsec of current position. Deploys only at parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Immune to Revolution. If this is your starting location, Light Side goes first in game. Light: -

name: R2-X2 (Artoo-Extoo)
text: While aboard any starfighter, adds 1 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed.

name: Gold 5
text: May add 2 pilots or passengers, and 1 astromech.

name: Red 3
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech.

name: Red 5
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Immune to attrition < 4 if Luke piloting. When firing in an Attack Run, adds 1 to total.

name: A Few Maneuvers
text: Add 2 to hyperspeed and maneuver of any starfighter for the remainder of this turn. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.)

name: Dark Maneuvers
text: Add 2 to maneuver and 1 to power of any starfighter for the remainder of this turn. If it has hyperdrive, also add 2 to hyperspeed. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.)

name: Tallon Roll
text: Target two starfighters (your TIE/ln and any Rebel starfighter) present at same system or sector. Each player draws destiny. Opponent totals destiny and starship's power. You total destiny, TIE's power and TIE's maneuver. Lowest total loses starfighter.

name: Corellian Slip
text: If opponent just initiated a Tallon Roll, add your maneuver + ability of one pilot on you targeted starfighter to your total. OR Decrease the maneuver of an opponent's starfighter by 1 for remainder of this turn.

name: Ion Cannon
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your Star Destroyer. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 > defense value, all starship weapons deployed on target are lost, armor or maneuver = 0 and hyperspeed = 0.

name: SW-4 Ion Cannon
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on your Y-wing or B-wing. May target a starship using 1 Force. Draw destiny. If destiny > target's defense value, all starship weapons deployed on target are lost, armor or maneuver = 0 and hyperspeed = 0.

name: R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)
text: While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.

name: R5-A2 (Arfive-Aytoo)
text: While aboard any starship, adds 1 to power and maneuver. During your control phase, if aboard your starship damaged by an ion cannon, restores armor/maneuver and hyperspeed.

name: Hyper Escape
text: If a battle was just initiated at any system or sector, move all your starships and vehicles there away.

name: Biggs Darklighter
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 3, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Wedge Antilles
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 2, also adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 1 Force to take one Corellian Slip into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

name: DS-61-2
text: Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Black 2, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Red 2
text: May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. Immune to attrition < 3 if Wedge piloting.

name: Black 2
text: May add 1 pilot.

name: Jek Porkins
text: Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting Red 6, also adds 1 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

name: Red 6
text: May add 1 pilot. Opponent may add 2 to destiny drawn for I've Got A Problem Here when targeting Red 6.

name: I've Got A Problem Here
text: Use 1 Force to target opponent's starfighter with maneuver at a system or sector where a battle just finished. Draw destiny. Starfighter lost if destiny > maneuver.

name: I've Lost Artoo!
text: Use 1 Force to deploy on a starship with a [Nav Computer] or astromech aboard. Target [Nav Computer] or astromech and draw destiny. If destiny > 1, astromech lost (lose Effect) or [Nav Computer] is canceled (may add 1 astromech); otherwise, Effect lost.

name: Asteroid Field
text: Dark: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here. If you control, may cancel Force drain at related system. Light: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here.

name: Asteroid Field
text: Light: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here. If you control, may cancel Force drain at related system. Dark: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here.

name: Clouds
text: Dark: If you control, once per turn, may add 1 to a Force drain at a related site. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here. Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.

name: Clouds
text: Light: If you control, once per turn, may add 1 to a Force drain at a related site. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here. Starships are power and maneuver -2 here.

name: Bespin
text: Light: If you control, opponent's characters and vehicles deploy +1 to Cloud City locations. Dark: If you control, your characters and vehicles deploy -1 to Cloud City locations.

name: Bespin
text: Dark: If you control, opponent's characters and vehicles deploy +1 to Cloud City locations. Light: If you control, your characters and vehicles deploy -1 to Cloud City locations.

name: Bespin: Cloud City
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships or vehicles here, your total power is +1 in battles at Cloud City sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships or vehicles here, your total power is +1 in battles at Cloud City sites.

name: Bespin: Cloud City
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships or vehicles here, your total power is +1 in battles at Cloud City sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships or vehicles here, your total power is +1 in battles at Cloud City sites.

name: Big One
text: Light: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here. If you control, Force drain +1 here for each Asteroid Field at same system. Dark: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here. If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Big One
text: Dark: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here. If you control, Force drain +1 here for each Asteroid Field at same system. Light: 'Asteroid Rules' in effect here.

name: Big One: Asteroid Cave Or Space Slug Belly
text: Light: 'Cave Rules' in effect here. If you control, may cancel Force drains at system Related to Big One. Dark: 'Cave Rules' in effect here.

name: Big One: Asteroid Cave Or Space Slug Belly
text: Dark: 'Cave Rules' in effect here. If you control, may cancel Force drains at system related to Big One. Light: 'Cave Rules' in effect here.

name: Space Slug
text: * Ferocity = two destiny. Habitat: Big One (Cave is now Belly). Attacks starfighters (defeated cards are eaten or relocated to Belly, opponent of victim chooses). Once per turn, may open or close mouth.

name: Space Slug
text: * Ferocity = two destiny. Habitat: Big One (Cave is now Belly). Attacks starfighters (defeated cards are eaten or relocated to Belly, opponent of victim chooses). Once per turn, may open or close mouth.

name: Worrt
text: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Does not attack your characters. When at a Tatooine site, prevents opponent's characters present from using their landspeed.

name: Bubo
text: Habitat: planet sites (except Hoth). Does not attack your characters. When at a Jabba's palace site, prevents opponent's characters from using their landspeed.

name: Wampa
text: * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or unoccupied marker site. Defeated characters are eaten or relocated to Wampa Cave (opponent of victim chooses).

name: One-Arm
text: Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to Wampa Cave. For remainder of game, all wampas are selective creatures.

name: Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker)
text: Dark: Your Wampas deploy free here. Light: If you control, and Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
text: Light: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. Your artillery weapons here are powered. Dark: 'Hoth Energy Shield Rules' in effect. If 'blown away,' Light Side loses 8 Force.

name: Hoth: Snow Trench (2nd Marker)
text: Light: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. Dark: If you control, Force generation +1 for you here.

name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
text: Light: Your Echo Base Troopers deploy -1 here. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Dark: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)
text: Dark: Add 1 to each of your weapon destiny draws here. If you control, Force drain +1 here. Light: Your troopers are forfeit -1 here.

name: Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
text: Light: This site does not count when calculating Epic Events. Dark: This site does not count when calculating Epic Events.

name: Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
text: Dark: Your AT-ATs move to here for free. Light:

name: Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)
text: Dark: During your move phase, you may move free from here directly to Mountains (or vice versa). Light: If you control, and Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here.

name: Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)
text: Dark: Your Imperials and combat vehicles deploy -1 here. Light: If you control, Force drain +1 here.

name: Hoth
text: Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites. Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

name: Hoth
text: Dark: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites. Light: If you control, for each of your starships here, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

name: Echo Base Trooper
text: Deploy only on Hoth, but may move elsewhere. Power -1 when at a site other than a Hoth site.

name: Blizzard 2
text: May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. Landspeed may not be increased.

name: AT-AT Cannon
text: Use 2 Force to deploy on your AT-AT. May target a starfighter (use 3 as defense value), character, creature or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a character or creature, 2 if a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.

name: Target The Main Generator
text: During your control phase, fire your AT-AT Cannon (if within range of the Main Power Generators) as follows: Prepare To Target The Main Generator: Draw destiny. Maximum Firepower!: If (destiny + X + Y) > 8, Main Power Generators site is blown away and this card is lost. Otherwise, this card is used. X = ability of one of your AT-AT's pilots. Y = total Hoth sites you control.
